label: prop:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder
title: $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ categorical-derivation precision ladder
html:
Proposition. \mathfrak{Q}_\beta categorical-derivation precision ladder

\mathfrak{Q}_\beta categorical-derivation precision ladder. This derives the free-neutron \beta-decay Q-value \mathfrak{Q}_\beta at the substrate q_0 via a four-rung categorical recursion. Residuals are quoted as (\mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{cat}} - \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{CODATA}}) / \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{CODATA}}, and the ladder approaches CODATA from above, so every rung is positive. At the muon-pin (CAL-2) q_0 this block is written in, the five-rung series reaches a +0.0071 ppm residual against CODATA, below the 0.0094 ppm N=3 c(K) ceiling from conj:archimedean-remainder-exponential-decay; at the canonical proton pin the same five rungs give +0.0377 ppm, which does not clear that ceiling.

\boxed{
  \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{cat}}
   \;=\;
   \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^A \cdot
   \cos\!\bigl(\alpha - \tfrac{b\,\hbar_q^2}{2}\bigr) \cdot
   \bigl(1 - b^2 \hbar_q^4\bigr) \cdot
   \bigl(1 - 2 \, b^3 \hbar_q^6\bigr) \cdot
   \bigl(1 - 2\,b^4 \cdot b^4 \hbar_q^8\bigr) \cdot
   \bigl(1 - (b^2 + \tfrac{1}{2})\, b^5 \hbar_q^{10}\bigr) \cdot \cdots
}

where:

  • \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^A = m_e \cdot |q^2 - 2q - 1| (q+1) / (2 q^3) is the single-wrap Form A baseline from prop:neutron-qvalue-symbolic;
  • \alpha = (z-1)h/2 is the single-wrap eigenphase on V_{(2,1)} (per prop:q-beta-spectral-bridge);
  • b = \sqrt{q^4+q^2+1}/(q^2+1) is the Hoefsmit off-diagonal coupling on V_{(2,1)} (per prop:hoefsmit-V21-cos-symmetrization);
  • \hbar_q = (q-1)/q is the substrate quantum Planck constant.

The per-rung categorical sources, the truncation-order and error analysis, the canonical precision ladder, the implication for the n{-}p mass split, and the open questions — together with the Habiro-ring supersession note — are collected in the precision-ladder derivation context.
